daily.title: Rupert Murdoch 'very happy' to be played by Guy Pearce in new film
daily.summary: A new film on the Australian-born media mogul is headlining the Venice Film Festival, with director Danny Boyle saying it takes a more sympathetic look at his early foray into British newspapers.

daily.title: Tiger Woods loses driving licence for five years after plea deal
daily.summary: The champion golfer submits a no contest pleas to a reckless driving charge after a crash near his Florida home in March.

daily.title: Iran accuses US of a 'war crime' after strikes kill people at wedding party
daily.summary: Iranian officials are comparing the incident to a strike on a girl's school on the first night of the war which killed 160 people.

daily.title: Armed gang raids security cars of gold in one of PNG's biggest robberies
daily.summary: Gold bars worth millions of dollars and thousands in cash have been stolen at gunpoint in a brazen heist in Papua New Guinea.

daily.title: Queensland Police receive safety notices over watch house conditions
daily.summary: Workplace Health and Safety issues multiple regulatory notices to the police service regarding conditions at the state's watch houses.

daily.title: Albanese bristles at pre-COP questions as UN delivers sobering report
daily.summary: A new UN report warns the world is likely to overshoot warming of 1.5C as world leaders shun Australia's pre-COP talks in Fiji.

daily.title: Ciraldo calls out NRL over delayed rule-change communication
daily.summary: Cameron Ciraldo says he only learned his team will act as guinea pigs this week for some new NRL rules via an email.

daily.title: Boy, 14, charged over alleged rock attack that left man unconscious
daily.summary: A 14-year-old boy is charged with assault after a man was seriously injured and left convulsing on the ground in an alleged rock throwing attack in a fast food restaurant car park.

daily.title: Darwin hospital opens new ward with hopes of easing capacity pressures
daily.summary: A new multi-purpose ward at the Northern Territory's largest hospital has received its first patients this week, with hopes the $24 million investment will help ease capacity pressures in Darwin's health sector.

daily.title: Victorian man defrauds women of more than $45,000 after meeting them online
daily.summary: Stephen Cross used a fake name to deceive women he met online, tricking some into giving him money.

daily.title: Car bomb, feuds and $5K to count 12 votes as NSW councils scrutinised
daily.summary: Local government may have a reputation for being boring, but NSW budget estimates today provided an extraordinary snapshot of what is playing out across the state's councils.

daily.title: Special school sexual abuse allegations with authorities, premier says
daily.summary: The Victorian premier says allegations of almost two decades of sexual abuse at a Traralgon special school are "harrowing".

daily.title: Premier urges Chinese, Indian coal firms to merge before funding stops
daily.summary: The state government throws its support behind a proposed merger between WA's last remaining coal miners as its self-imposed 2030 deadline to retire state-owned coal assets approaches.

daily.title: AFL boss backflips by scrapping controversial 'Opening Round' experiment
daily.summary: AFL CEO Andrew Dillon says the 2027 season will start with all 18 teams in action despite previously defending the staggered start.

daily.title: WA police drop AI seatbelt fines amid influx of complaints
daily.summary: Hundreds of fines issued via AI-assisted traffic cameras are being dropped in WA, with officers unable to prove drivers knew their passengers were wearing their seatbelts incorrectly.

daily.title: Brown and foul tasting: This town's water may be the tipping point of a crisis
daily.summary: In Australia's most decentralised state, water infrastructure is failing, leading residents in one town to rely on the bottled variety, but it comes at a cost.

daily.title: Police pursuit of emu just part of 'life of a country cop'
daily.summary: A video of a flightless bird being chased by a police officer down a road on the NSW Central Tablelands goes viral, with the local chief inspector saying it's all part of "the life of a country cop".

daily.title: Police investigating if fatal Sydney shooting a case of mistaken identity
daily.summary: Police say it is "tragically" possible that a man who was shot dead on a Western Sydney street was another case of mistaken identity.

daily.title: Former Bondi Rescue lifeguard Matt Dee dies
daily.summary: Well-known former Bondi Rescue cast member and mental health advocate Matt Dee has died, according to a statement posted online by the clothing and events company he co-founded.

daily.title: Fatal hit-and-run driver thought he had hit animal, court hears
daily.summary: A 20-year-old hit-and-run driver who fatally struck a woman in Adelaide's north-east has apologised to his victim's family in court, which heard he did not initially realise he had hit a person.

daily.title: Police speak with four men over Sydney Swans scandal
daily.summary: Victoria Police detectives confirm they have spoken with four Sydney men as part of their sexual assault investigation linked to the Sydney Swans.

daily.title: Judge tells retiring triple murder jury to consider if survivor truthful
daily.summary: A jury has retired to consider its verdict in the trial of a Queensland grazier accused of a triple murder and an attempted murder.

daily.title: 'The Family' serial killings suspects should be named, victims' relatives say
daily.summary: Relatives of some of the victims of "The Family" murders are demanding the public release of the long-suppressed names of suspects linked to the case.

daily.title: Another plan unveiled to tackle long-standing issues in Port Augusta
daily.summary: The state government has announced another plan to tackle issues regarding crime, violence and substance abuse in Port Augusta. The efforts have been praised by Indigenous leaders who say it is needed, but have criticised the lack of Indigenous consultation.

daily.title: The turquoise home that withstood a torrent
daily.summary: Inside the turquoise house close to the riverbank, a mother of two, her husband, daughter and in-laws remained stranded on their balcony as the flood tore through their Nepali town.
